title: Python vector script: show base58btc encoding step
description: The Python generation script comment in did_verify.rs tests uses '# ... base58btc-encode [0xed, 0x01] + pub_bytes with z multibase prefix' with an ellipsis rather than showing the actual Python. A maintainer who needs to regenerate vectors must independently discover how to base58btc-encode with multibase prefix in Python. The comment should show the complete encoding snippet (e.g. using the base58 pip package and prefixing 'z').
